race.comment: BRAVE ART (5) was responsible for a very good effort last time over 1790m at Ararat, finishing second and just 1.4 metres from the winner. Tackles a similar assignment and she can take this out. OUTBACK QUEENIE (6) ran third last start at St Arnaud over 2150m, beaten 11 metres. Has ability and should be right in the finish. TAP TO PAY (4) last appeared when eighth over 2190m at Mildura eight months ago. Expect a better effort to kick off this prep. HALF PRICE BRIDE (3) is worth some thought after her last-start sixth over 2240m at Melton on November 11.
